function.name: wildlife_population_assess_growth
function.description: Assesses a species' population growth at a location over a period. Unlike ecological_impact_analyze, which analyzes impact on a particular ecosystem, this assesses population growth.

location.description: The area where the species is present.

function.name: ecological_impact_analyze
function.description: Analyzes the impact of a species on a particular ecosystem. Unlike wildlife_population_assess_growth, which assesses population growth, this analyzes impact on a particular ecosystem.

species.description: The species whose impact is to be calculated.

location.description: The area where the impact is analyzed.
